one_line: Autonomous naval commander of Malabar whose sea fortress at Kottakkal fell to a combined Zamorin–Portuguese assault in 1599–1600, later remembered as a symbol of maritime resistance.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, lean but strong, wiry sailor’s build
appearance.face: oval face, medium brown Malabar complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, intense almond-shaped eyes with a steady, calculating gaze, default expression calm and resolute with a hint of defiant pride
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a low knot at the nape, partly covered by a dark indigo cotton turban wrapped close to the head with a narrow white band at the base and a small knotted tail tucked to one side
appearance.costume: era-accurate late-16th-century Malabar admiral’s outfit: a long-sleeved cream cotton angarkha-style upper garment crossing right over left and tied with hidden side ties, worn over a fitted dark indigo waistcoat-like sleeveless vest ending just above the hip; below, a deep brown cotton dhoti tightly wrapped and pleated, falling to the ankles with a clean front panel and a slightly shorter front to show simple dark leather sandals; around his waist a broad crimson cotton sash wound twice and knotted on his left hip with the tail hanging to mid-thigh; over the left shoulder a lightweight off-white cotton shawl with a subtle thin gold border draped diagonally across the torso and tucked into the sash at the right hip; simple gold stud earrings, a plain iron signet ring on the right hand, and a dark wooden prayer-bead bracelet on the left wrist.
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Malabar tulwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel, carried sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, worn slung from the crimson waist sash on his left side so the hilt angles forward for a ready naval commander’s grip.

ref_desc: Kunjali Marakkar IV is a mid-40s, lean Malabar admiral with a neatly bearded oval face, black hair in a low knot under an indigo turban, wearing a cream angarkha, indigo vest, brown dhoti, crimson sash and off-white shawl, carrying a curved tulwar in a brown scabbard, in cream, indigo, brown, crimson and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Kunjali Marakkar IV, a mid-40s lean Malabar naval commander with a medium brown complexion, oval face, intense almond eyes, sharp nose, and a neatly trimmed full beard and moustache. His thick black hair is pulled into a low knot at the nape and partly covered by a dark indigo cotton turban wrapped snugly with a narrow white band at its base and a small knotted tail tucked to one side. He wears a long-sleeved cream cotton angarkha-style upper garment crossing right over left, tied with concealed side ties, over a fitted dark indigo sleeveless vest that ends just above the hip. His lower garment is a deep brown cotton dhoti, tightly wrapped and pleated, reaching the ankles, paired with simple dark leather sandals. A broad crimson cotton sash is wound twice around his waist and knotted on his left hip, with its tail hanging to mid-thigh, and a lightweight off-white cotton shawl with a thin gold border is draped over his left shoulder, running diagonally across his torso and tucked into the sash at the right hip. He has small gold stud earrings, a plain iron ring on his right hand, and a dark wooden prayer-bead bracelet on his left wrist. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Malabar tulwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, hanging from the crimson sash at his left side with the hilt angled forward. Use cream, indigo, deep brown, crimson, and gold as the dominant colours, and pose him in a calm but resolute stance that suggests disciplined leadership at sea.
